benchmark: DK-Mem Tier-2 controlled multi-session injection benchmark: v1.1m mirror (counter-confound) arm
design: 69 conversations, each the v1.0 conversation with ids renamed t2c_->t2m_ and only member b's sentence replaced: gold-different pairs state a DIFFERENT attribute, gold-same pairs the SAME attribute with a CONFLICTING value. Labels, markers, session positions and distractors are v1.0's. Together with v1.0 the relation is balanced over the attribute pattern in every class x relation stratum.
limitations: no QA questions (merge-decision arm only; v1.0 keeps its QA)
labels inherit the provisional Tier-1 gold and the v1.0 design assumptions (name_variant different read at the person level; German register pairs as two addressees)
class, relation and language stay confounded as in v1.0 (kinship all different, Hindi register all same, German register all different)
changing the attribute changes the surface similarity, so the retrieval stage may compare different pairs at another rate than in v1.0: report retrieval status per arm
the six German replacement sentences are hand-written; all others are templated from the v1.0 vocabulary
